import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to confirm
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m ({scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path

import time
import os

opmode = application.OperatingMode

head = application.ScanHead

scan.StartFrameUp()

    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Scan size set to: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to confirm
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m ({scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The image is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the gallery path and latest file
try:
    gallery_path = application.GalleryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List files in gallery path to find the most recent
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path)]
        if files:
            # Get the most recently modified file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getmtime)
            print(f"Latest file: {latest_file}")
        else:
            print("No files found in gallery path")
    else:
        print(f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to confirm
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m ({scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Scan size set to: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

import nanosurf

head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image

scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")

print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Scan size set to: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Scan size set to: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Get the last saved file path
last_file = scan.LastSavedFile
print(f"Image saved at: {last_file}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time

#load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start scan
# scan.StartFrameDown() #Scanning from up to down or top to bottom

#scan.stop() #stop sacn

while scanning:
        print("Scanning in progress... Remaining lines:",(scan.Lines-scan.Currentline))
        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

try:
    # Try to get the file path
    file_path = scan.FilePath
    print(f"File path: {file_path}")
except:
    print("Could not get FilePath property")

try:
    # Try to get the file name
    file_name = scan.FileName
    print(f"File name: {file_name}")
except:
    print("Could not get FileName property")

try:

    directory = scan.Directory
    print(f"Directory: {directory}")

    print("Could not get Directory property")

for attr in dir(scan):
    if not attr.startswith('_') and 'file' in attr.lower() or 'path' in attr.lower() or 'dir' in attr.lower():
        print(f"  {attr}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to confirm
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m ({scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Try to get the last saved file path
try:
    # Get the gallery history path (where images are saved)
    gallery_path = application.GetGalleryHistoryPath()
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # Get the filename mask
    filename_mask = application.GetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask()
    print(f"Filename mask: {filename_mask}")
    
    # List files in the gallery directory to find the most recent one
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path)]
        if files:
            # Get the most recent file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getctime)
            print(f"Latest file: {latest_file}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to confirm
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m ({scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The image should be automatically saved by the AFM software
# Try to get the current working directory and gallery path
try:
    gallery_path = application.GetGalleryPath()
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve gallery path directly")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Get current scan parameters to confirm
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m ({scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m ({scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm)")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The image is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the gallery path and latest file
try:
    gallery_path = application.GalleryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List files in gallery path to find the most recent
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path)]
        if files:
            # Get the most recently modified file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getmtime)
            print(f"Latest file: {latest_file}")
        else:
            print("No files found in gallery path")
    else:
        print(f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")

del spm
